Samir P.: Heads-up 1: Vendor rebate file applied as revenue reduction instead of deferral for multi-month partner rebates. Hit recognized revenue for May close. File rebate_lines_may_2026.csv.
Olivia R.: How big is the hit? materiality?
Samir P.: Preliminary run shows gross impact = 91,420 USD across 9 customers; recognized portion incorrectly reduced P&L instead of creating a deferred liability to amortize over contract term.
Tony N.: Oof, 91.4k > our 50k threshold. This will need an adjusting journal or restatement. Do we know contract terms for each rebate?
Hannah G.: Most rebates are annual commitment credits amortized monthly over 12 months. So the correct treatment is to credit Deferred Revenue and DR Cash/AR depending on flow.
Samir P.: Example proposed adjusting JE (USD) for May close:
```nDR Hosted Revenue (4001)    91,420
CR Deferred Revenue (2100)   91,420
Memo: "Adjusting JE to reclassify vendor rebate lines applied to revenue; file rebate_lines_may_2026.csv; reversing when vendor correction applied or amortized per contract."
```nOlivia R.: Approve in principle. Need spreadsheet with invoice ids/customer ids, contract amortization schedules, vendor confirmation, and ops import logs. Also require ticket with root cause and evidence of fix for audit.
RevRecBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-REB-282345 (title: Vendor rebate applied to recognized revenue 91.42k manual reclass required)
Tony N.: Eng/billing: can you re-run adapter with corrected mapping so rebate lines map to rebate_credit event instead of revenue_reverse? Run dry-run and attach logs + checksum. ETA?
Samir P.: Eng said they can hotfix mapping in billing transform and reprocess within 12 hours. I'll pull together the JE packet.
Hannah G.: Also consider FX: some lines originated in EUR; ensure we use the spot rate used on recognition date for reversal and document the fx gain/loss treatment.
Olivia R.: Finance approves the adjusting JE posting for month-end provided the packet includes: spreadsheet, ticket, vendor email confirming intended rebate treatment, dry-run import logs, and JE memo. Post as of 2026-05-31 and reverse or reclass when corrected import completes.
Samir P.: I'll circulate the spreadsheet and tag @finance-ops and @eng-billing. Timeline: spreadsheet by EOD PT, JE to post tomorrow AM after sign-off, re-run and verification within 24 hrs.
Tony N.: Noted. We'll include a short postmortem and changelog of the transform mapping in the ticket.
Olivia R.: Flagging for month-end exceptions appendix and disclosure team in case external restatement is required.
Samir P.: Thanks all. tagging @finance-ops and @revrec :white_check_mark:
